name: Your First Java Program
overview: Get 'Hello, World!' onto the screen, then trace how Java found your code. The first line of output is small. Knowing why it ran is the win.

sections.title: Give the file a home
sections.content: In the classic form, put optional package and import declarations before the class. When compiling a public class named HelloWorld, name the source file HelloWorld.java.

images.caption: The classic form declares the class and its main method explicitly.

sections.title: Start at main
sections.content: The classic signature is public static void main(String[] args). Static lets the launcher call it without an instance. The array holds command-line arguments.

sections.title: Compile, run, and try the shorter form
sections.content: Compile HelloWorld.java with javac, then run java HelloWorld. Java 25 also supports compact source files and eligible instance or no-argument main methods.

codeExamples.title: The Classic Hello World
codeExamples.description: The program that started billions of Java journeys

keyPoints: Compile and run the classic example, pass it an argument, and explain how that word reached main.

references.title: Java Virtual Machine Specification - Loading, Linking, and Initializing

interviewQA.question: Why does the classic main use static?
interviewQA.answer: The launcher can invoke it without constructing the class.

interviewQA.question: Can main return an int as the entry point?
interviewQA.answer: The entry point returns void. Use System.exit when you need to set an explicit process exit status.
